messages:
erin (PM): Quick thread: need a minimal, auditable gating matrix for the regional+isolation roadmap. Keep it tiny for legal review.

kai (Eng): propose micro-flow: sandbox smoke -> 1-tenant staging canary -> 3% prod for 6h -> 25% -> full. Each step has a short observation window.

sam (Arch): add a hard block: if KV miss > 12% and cold-start p95 > 1.8x baseline, halt rollout. Include model-variant fallback precedence.

mica (SRE): ops must have alerts (tenant.p99.spike, region.failover.init), a runbook for slice pinning, and a smoke harness hitting top-20 prompts every 15m. Fail -> rollback.

lee (Sales): customer asks for 30s RTO. realistic?

kai (Eng): routing switch can be initiated <60s; full perf restoration depends on cache and can be minutes. Suggest contract wording: "automated routing switch within 60s; expected full performance restoration within 10 minutes under normal load".

sam (Arch): policy: SLA-triggered isolation. If tenant p99 > 250ms for 5m, auto-move to isolated lane with a 15m grace period to avoid oscillation.

erin (PM): action items: @kai - PR for routing policy with canary hooks; @mica - runbook + chaos test; @sam - write isolation policy doc; @lee - confirm contract phrasing with customer. guardian-bot: created ticket ARCH-3467 for tracking.

lei (Sales): noted, will push legal. erin (PM): publishing draft gating matrix by EOD for quick signoff.
